name: Start Here
description: New to Interactive Guides? Begin with these orientation lessons to learn how the platform works and get set up for success.

name: Web Basics
description: Understand the foundational technologies of the web — HTML structure, CSS styling, and how browsers render pages.

name: JavaScript
description: Master the language of the web, from variables and functions to async patterns and modern ES modules.

name: React
description: Build modern user interfaces with components, hooks, state management, and the React rendering model.

name: UI / Design
description: Learn design principles, color theory, typography, spacing, and how to create interfaces that feel intuitive and polished.

name: Tooling
description: Set up your development workflow with build tools, package managers, linters, formatters, and version control.

name: Quality
description: Write code that lasts — testing strategies, debugging techniques, error handling, and code review best practices.

name: Security
description: Protect your applications from common vulnerabilities — XSS, CSRF, injection attacks, and modern security headers.

name: Data
description: Work with data effectively — REST APIs, GraphQL, caching strategies, local storage, and state synchronization.
